translation: O Gopīnāth, please remove the torment of worldly existence. I can no longer tolerate the pain of ignorance and the repeated succession of rebirth and death.
O Gopīnāth, indeed I am a servant of lust. Worldly desires are awakening in my heart, and thus the noose of fruitive work is beginning to tighten.
O Gopīnāth, when will I wake up and abandon afar this enemy of lust, and when will You manifest Yourself in my heart?
O Gopīnāth, I am Your devotee, but having abandoned You and thus having forgotten my real treasure, I have worshipped this mundane world.
O Gopīnāth, You know everything. Now, having punished Your servant, please give him a place at Your lotus feet.
O Gopīnāth, is this Your judgement, that seeing me averse to You, You abandon Your servant and don’t bestow even a particle of mercy upon him?

text: kise bhāla haya    kabhu nā bujhinu
translation: O Gopīnāth, I am certainly very foolish, and I have never known what is good for me. Therefore such is my condition.
O Gopīnāth, You are indeed the wisest person. Please look for a way to bring about auspiciousness for this fool, and please do not consider this servant as an outsider.
